description: Cutaneous melanoma case TCGA-D9-A3Z1 from the TCGA-SKCM cohort, open tier: one patient's GDC-masked somatic MAF (WXS ensemble callset, 591 records) against a matched blood normal, plus the same patient's STAR gene-expression TPM. Demonstrates the pipeline on a second, heterogeneously shaped input modality; L1 measured layers only for presentation inputs (no same-patient HLA genotype exists in the open tier).
pairing_provenance: Both aliquots appear in every row of the ensemble masked MAF (Tumor_Sample_Barcode / Matched_Norm_Sample_Barcode) and come from one GDC case (case_id 4f7e7a0e-4aa2-4b6a-936f-6429c7d6a2a7, submitter_id TCGA-D9-A3Z1); the harness refuses files carrying more than one sample barcode. Expression is the same patient's tumour RNA aliquot (-06A-01R) from GDC STAR analysis 2334018b-2e20-4c8b-a844-14f3b15f83ab; no cross-patient or cross-source molecular inputs are combined.

somatic_maf.role: L1: open GDC Masked Somatic Mutation MAF (WXS, ensemble callset), GDC file 02de9cd7-94e2-470c-b2ac-9fe6285b50db, 591 records

expression_star_tsv.role: L1: measured gene expression, same patient's tumour RNA aliquot, GDC file 631ef22b-0162-47a7-9dd0-c1d33f9a1de5 (STAR, GENCODE v36 model)

hla.reason: the only TCGA patient-level class-I OptiType calls (Immune Landscape of Cancer) are GDC controlled-access (HTTP 403 without a token); no open same-patient HLA genotype exists, so no presentation/prioritisation is run for this case

expression.matrix: GDC rna_seq.augmented_star_gene_counts.tsv (tumour sample TCGA-D9-A3Z1-06A-01R); tpm_unstranded copied verbatim
